Context c-1374 carries InvestmentOwnedAtCost 54200000 and InvestmentOwnedAtFairValue 35600000, decimals -5, on the identifier 'WHCG Purchaser III, Inc.' and nothing else. The schedule positions are 'WHCG Purchaser III, Inc. 1' (c-352: 102,373 par, 66,542 fair value) and 'WHCG Purchaser III, Inc. 2' (c-353: 12,455 par, 8,085 fair value).

Fund sandbox 'five14' (2026-10-06): over 15 quarters 2022-09-30 to 2026-03-31 the predicate selects one published row, the WHCG row at 2024-06-30. The fund's published total was 35,600,000 above fund_financials investments_at_fair_value in that quarter and equals it without the row. Re-run: python scripts/v05_evidence/bcred_footnote_rows.py five14

rationale: The filer tags a footnote figure (the non-accrual portion of an issuer's loans, rounded to 0.1 million) with the investment identifier axis. It carries cost and fair value only. Schedule positions carry principal or units and a percent of net assets, and are filed to the thousand. The rule is structural and covers every quarter so that the same footnote in a later filing is excluded too. Residual risk: a real position filed with round-100,000 cost and fair value and no principal, units, rate or percent would be excluded; none exists in 15 quarters. Authored in an interactive session under the owner's permission of 2026-10-06 and checked by fund-sandbox reconciliation, not by the fleet promotion gate.
